definitions.explanation: Lacking good judgment or sense; acting in an ill-considered or thoughtless manner. Often describes actions or decisions rather than inherent intelligence.

examples.japanese: {愚|おろ}かな⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}して→犯す：10059_okasu⟧しまった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愚|おろ}かだった。
{愚|おろ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}して→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧しまった。

notes:
CONJUGATION (as na-adjective):
- {愚|おろ}かな + noun ({愚|おろ}かな⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ - a foolish act)
- {愚|おろ}かだ (predicative form)
- {愚|おろ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({愚|おろ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - foolishly)

USAGE:
Commonly modifies actions, decisions, or behaviors rather than people directly:
- {愚|おろ}かな⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧/⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (foolish action/behavior)
- {愚|おろ}かな⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (unwise judgment)
- {愚|おろ}かな⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ (foolish thinking)

COMMON PATTERN:
{愚|おろ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧も〜 - foolishly did ~
This pattern emphasizes regret or self-criticism for an unwise action.

RELATED WORDS:
- {愚|おろ}かさ (noun form - foolishness)
- {愚|ぐ} (foolishness, in compounds like ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ばか (stupid, foolish - more casual/direct)
- ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}げた→馬鹿げる：26854_bakageru⟧ (ridiculous, absurd)
- ⟦{浅|あさ}はか→浅はか：13313_asahaka⟧ (shallow-minded, thoughtless)
